question_ru: Сколько всего клиентов в базе?
question_en: How many customers are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

question_ru: Выведи названия всех товаров категории 'Electronics'.
question_en: List the names of all products in the 'Electronics' category.
sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE category = 'Electronics'

question_ru: Какой товар самый дорогой? Выведи название и цену.
question_en: What is the most expensive product? Show its name and price.
sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1

question_ru: Сколько заказов имеют статус 'cancelled'?
question_en: How many orders have the status 'cancelled'?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

question_ru: Какова средняя цена товара?
question_en: What is the average product price?
sql: SELECT AVG(price) FROM products

question_ru: Выведи имена премиум-клиентов из города 'Kazan'.
question_en: List the names of premium customers from the city 'Kazan'.
sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE is_premium = 1 AND city = 'Kazan'

question_ru: Сколько клиентов в каждом городе? Выведи город и количество.
question_en: How many customers are in each city? Show the city and the count.
sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY city

question_ru: Какие категории имеют среднюю цену товара выше 100?
question_en: Which categories have an average product price above 100?
sql: SELECT category FROM products GROUP BY category HAVING AVG(price) > 100

question_ru: Какова общая выручка по заказам со статусом 'delivered'? Выручка позиции — количество, умноженное на цену за единицу.
question_en: What is the total revenue of orders with status 'delivered'? Line revenue is quantity times unit price.
sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered'

question_ru: Выведи имена клиентов, которые ни разу не делали заказ.
question_en: List the names of customers who have never placed an order.
sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders)

question_ru: Сколько заказов было сделано в 2025 году?
question_en: How many orders were placed in 2025?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2025'

question_ru: Выведи 3 товара с наибольшим суммарным количеством проданных единиц: название и количество, по убыванию.
question_en: Show the top 3 products by total quantity sold: name and quantity, in descending order.
sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_qty FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY total_qty DESC LIMIT 3

question_ru: Выведи имена клиентов, сделавших больше 7 заказов, и количество их заказов.
question_en: List the names of customers who placed more than 7 orders, along with their order count.
sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 7

question_ru: Посчитай выручку по каждой категории товаров только по доставленным заказам (статус 'delivered'). Выведи категорию и выручку по убыванию выручки.
question_en: Compute revenue per product category for delivered orders only (status 'delivered'). Show the category and revenue, sorted by revenue descending.
sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC

question_ru: Какой клиент потратил больше всех на доставленные заказы (статус 'delivered')? Выведи имя и сумму.
question_en: Which customer spent the most on delivered orders (status 'delivered')? Show the name and the amount.
sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY spent DESC LIMIT 1

question_ru: Выведи названия товаров, которые ни разу не заказывали.
question_en: List the names of products that have never been ordered.
sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE product_id NOT IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_items)

question_ru: Какой процент заказов имеет статус 'cancelled'?
question_en: What percentage of orders have the status 'cancelled'?
sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM orders

question_ru: Какова средняя сумма одного заказа? Сумма заказа — сумма количества, умноженного на цену за единицу, по всем его позициям.
question_en: What is the average order total? An order total is the sum of quantity times unit price over its items.
sql: SELECT AVG(total) FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS total FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id)

question_ru: Сколько разных клиентов покупали товары категории 'Books'?
question_en: How many distinct customers bought products from the 'Books' category?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Books'

question_ru: В каком городе клиенты принесли наибольшую выручку по доставленным заказам (статус 'delivered')? Выведи только город.
question_en: Which city's customers generated the highest revenue from delivered orders (status 'delivered')? Show only the city.
sql: SELECT c.city FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 1

question_ru: Сколько студентов поступило в 2023 году?
question_en: How many students enrolled in 2023?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE enrollment_year = 2023

question_ru: Выведи названия курсов, у которых больше 4 кредитов.
question_en: List the titles of courses worth more than 4 credits.
sql: SELECT title FROM courses WHERE credits > 4

question_ru: Выведи имена студентов из группы 'IT-301'.
question_en: List the names of students in group 'IT-301'.
sql: SELECT name FROM students WHERE group_name = 'IT-301'

question_ru: Сколько всего преподавателей?
question_en: How many teachers are there in total?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM teachers

question_ru: Сколько студентов получают стипендию?
question_en: How many students receive a scholarship?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE scholarship = 1

question_ru: Сколько студентов в каждой группе? Выведи группу и количество.
question_en: How many students are in each group? Show the group and the count.
sql: SELECT group_name, COUNT(*) FROM students GROUP BY group_name

question_ru: Какой средний балл по курсу 'Databases'?
question_en: What is the average grade in the course 'Databases'?
sql: SELECT AVG(e.grade) FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c ON c.course_id = e.course_id WHERE c.title = 'Databases'

question_ru: Выведи имена преподавателей кафедры 'Computer Science'.
question_en: List the names of teachers in the 'Computer Science' department.
sql: SELECT t.name FROM teachers t JOIN departments d ON d.department_id = t.department_id WHERE d.name = 'Computer Science'

question_ru: Выведи название каждого курса и имя преподавателя, который его ведёт.
question_en: Show each course title together with the name of the teacher who teaches it.
sql: SELECT c.title, t.name FROM courses c JOIN teachers t ON t.teacher_id = c.teacher_id

question_ru: Выведи имена студентов, которые хотя бы раз получили оценку 2.
question_en: List the names of students who received a grade of 2 at least once.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.name FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON e.student_id = s.student_id WHERE e.grade = 2

question_ru: Сколько курсов ведёт каждый преподаватель? Выведи имя преподавателя и число курсов (только тех, кто ведёт хотя бы один курс).
question_en: How many courses does each teacher teach? Show the teacher name and number of courses (only teachers with at least one course).
sql: SELECT t.name, COUNT(*) FROM teachers t JOIN courses c ON c.teacher_id = t.teacher_id GROUP BY t.teacher_id

question_ru: Какой средний балл студентов по курсам каждой кафедры? Выведи название кафедры и средний балл.
question_en: What is the average student grade for courses of each department? Show the department name and the average grade.
sql: SELECT d.name, AVG(e.grade) FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c ON c.course_id = e.course_id JOIN teachers t ON t.teacher_id = c.teacher_id JOIN departments d ON d.department_id = t.department_id GROUP BY d.department_id

question_ru: Выведи имена студентов, у которых средний балл выше 4.5.
question_en: List the names of students whose average grade is above 4.5.
sql: SELECT s.name FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON e.student_id = s.student_id GROUP BY s.student_id HAVING AVG(e.grade) > 4.5

question_ru: Выведи имена преподавателей, которые не ведут ни одного курса.
question_en: List the names of teachers who do not teach any course.
sql: SELECT name FROM teachers WHERE teacher_id NOT IN (SELECT teacher_id FROM courses WHERE teacher_id IS NOT NULL)

question_ru: Сколько студентов поступило в каждом году? Выведи год и количество, отсортировав по году.
question_en: How many students enrolled each year? Show the year and the count, sorted by year.
sql: SELECT enrollment_year, COUNT(*) FROM students GROUP BY enrollment_year ORDER BY enrollment_year

question_ru: Для каждого курса посчитай, сколько студентов сдали его (оценка 3 и выше). Выведи название курса и количество.
question_en: For each course, count how many students passed it (grade 3 or higher). Show the course title and the count.
sql: SELECT c.title, COUNT(*) FROM courses c JOIN enrollments e ON e.course_id = c.course_id WHERE e.grade >= 3 GROUP BY c.course_id

question_ru: Какова сумма кредитов всех курсов?
question_en: What is the total number of credits across all courses?
sql: SELECT SUM(credits) FROM courses

question_ru: Выведи названия кафедр, на которых работает больше 3 преподавателей.
question_en: List the names of departments that have more than 3 teachers.
sql: SELECT d.name FROM departments d JOIN teachers t ON t.department_id = d.department_id GROUP BY d.department_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 3

question_ru: Выведи названия курсов, на которые не записан ни один студент.
question_en: List the titles of courses that no student is enrolled in.
sql: SELECT title FROM courses WHERE course_id NOT IN (SELECT course_id FROM enrollments)

question_ru: У какой группы самый высокий средний балл? Выведи только название группы.
question_en: Which group has the highest average grade? Show only the group name.
sql: SELECT s.group_name FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON e.student_id = s.student_id GROUP BY s.group_name ORDER BY AVG(e.grade) DESC LIMIT 1

question_ru: Сколько книг в библиотеке?
question_en: How many books are in the library?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM books

question_ru: Выведи названия книг в жанре 'Fantasy'.
question_en: List the titles of books in the 'Fantasy' genre.
sql: SELECT title FROM books WHERE genre = 'Fantasy'

question_ru: Выведи имена авторов из страны 'Russia'.
question_en: List the names of authors from the country 'Russia'.
sql: SELECT name FROM authors WHERE country = 'Russia'

question_ru: Выведи названия книг, изданных до 1950 года.
question_en: List the titles of books published before 1950.
sql: SELECT title FROM books WHERE published_year < 1950

question_ru: Сколько выдач книг ещё не вернули (дата возврата не указана)?
question_en: How many loans have not been returned yet (no return date)?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loans WHERE return_date IS NULL

question_ru: Сколько книг в каждом жанре? Выведи жанр и количество.
question_en: How many books are in each genre? Show the genre and the count.
sql: SELECT genre, COUNT(*) FROM books GROUP BY genre

question_ru: Выведи названия книг автора 'Anna Volkova'.
question_en: List the titles of books written by 'Anna Volkova'.
sql: SELECT b.title FROM books b JOIN authors a ON a.author_id = b.author_id WHERE a.name = 'Anna Volkova'

question_ru: Какое среднее число страниц у книг каждого жанра? Выведи жанр и среднее.
question_en: What is the average number of pages per genre? Show the genre and the average.
sql: SELECT genre, AVG(pages) FROM books GROUP BY genre

question_ru: Выведи имена читателей из города 'Perm', которые брали хотя бы одну книгу.
question_en: List the names of readers from the city 'Perm' who borrowed at least one book.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT r.name FROM readers r JOIN loans l ON l.reader_id = r.reader_id WHERE r.city = 'Perm'

question_ru: Выведи 2 самые популярные книги по числу выдач: название и количество выдач, по убыванию.
question_en: Show the 2 most borrowed books: title and number of loans, in descending order.
sql: SELECT b.title, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM loans l JOIN books b ON b.book_id = l.book_id GROUP BY b.book_id ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 2

question_ru: Выведи имена читателей, у которых на руках больше одной невозвращённой книги.
question_en: List the names of readers who currently have more than one unreturned book.
sql: SELECT r.name FROM readers r JOIN loans l ON l.reader_id = r.reader_id WHERE l.return_date IS NULL GROUP BY r.reader_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

question_ru: Сколько выдач книг было в 2025 году?
question_en: How many loans were made in 2025?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loans WHERE strftime('%Y', loan_date) = '2025'

question_ru: Выведи имена авторов, ни одну книгу которых ни разу не брали.
question_en: List the names of authors none of whose books has ever been borrowed.
sql: SELECT name FROM authors WHERE author_id NOT IN (SELECT b.author_id FROM books b JOIN loans l ON l.book_id = b.book_id)

question_ru: Выведи названия книг, изданных в самом раннем году среди всех книг библиотеки.
question_en: List the titles of the books published in the earliest year among all books in the library.
sql: SELECT title FROM books WHERE published_year = (SELECT MIN(published_year) FROM books)

question_ru: Сколько дней в среднем длится выдача книги? Учитывай только возвращённые книги.
question_en: What is the average loan duration in days? Consider only returned loans.
sql: SELECT AVG(julianday(return_date) - julianday(loan_date)) FROM loans WHERE return_date IS NOT NULL

question_ru: Сколько книг написали авторы из каждой страны? Выведи страну и количество книг.
question_en: How many books were written by authors from each country? Show the country and the number of books.
sql: SELECT a.country, COUNT(*) FROM books b JOIN authors a ON a.author_id = b.author_id GROUP BY a.country

question_ru: Книги какого жанра берут чаще всего? Выведи только жанр.
question_en: Books of which genre are borrowed most often? Show only the genre.
sql: SELECT b.genre FROM loans l JOIN books b ON b.book_id = l.book_id GROUP BY b.genre ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question_ru: Выведи имена читателей, которые записались в библиотеку в 2024 году.
question_en: List the names of readers who joined the library in 2024.
sql: SELECT name FROM readers WHERE join_year = 2024

question_ru: Сколько книг объёмом больше 500 страниц?
question_en: How many books have more than 500 pages?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM books WHERE pages > 500

question_ru: Выведи имена читателей, бравших книги не меньше 10 раз, и число их выдач.
question_en: List the names of readers with at least 10 loans and their number of loans.
sql: SELECT r.name, COUNT(*) FROM readers r JOIN loans l ON l.reader_id = r.reader_id GROUP BY r.reader_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
